name: Meeting Notification V 13
definition: Scope|The MeetingNotification message is sent by a notifying party, for example, an issuer, its agent or an intermediary to another intermediary, a party holding the right to vote, a registered security holder or to a beneficial holder to announce a meeting.|Usage|The MeetingNotification message is used to announce a meeting, for example, it provides information on the participation details and requirements for the meeting, the vote parameters and the resolutions. The MeetingNotification message may also be used to announce an update.|This message definition is intended for use with the Business Application Header (BAH).

Pagination.name: Pagination
Pagination.definition: Page number of the message and continuation indicator to indicate that the multi-part notification is to continue or that the message is the last page of the multi-part notification.

NotificationGeneralInformation.name: Notification General Information
NotificationGeneralInformation.definition: General information about the event notification type and status.

NotificationUpdate.name: Notification Update
NotificationUpdate.definition: Information specific to notification amendment as for instance the identification to a previous meeting notification.

EventsLinkage.name: Events Linkage
EventsLinkage.definition: Identification of another meeting event that needs to be closely linked to the processing of the event notified in this meeting notification.

Meeting.name: Meeting
Meeting.definition: Information about the meeting like meeting identifications, various deadlines, contact persons, electronic and postal locations for accessing information and proxy assignment parameters.

MeetingDetails.name: Meeting Details
MeetingDetails.definition: Dates and details of the shareholders meeting.

Issuer.name: Issuer
Issuer.definition: Institution that is the issuer of the security to which the meeting applies.

Security.name: Security
Security.definition: Financial instrument identification and net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities account.

Resolution.name: Resolution
Resolution.definition: Detailed information of a resolution proposed to the vote.

Vote.name: Vote
Vote.definition: Conditions for voting, the different voting methods and options, the voting deadlines and the parameters of the incentive premium.

PowerOfAttorneyRequirements.name: Power Of Attorney Requirements
PowerOfAttorneyRequirements.definition: Information about the use of power of attorney.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional narrative information about the meeting event.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.

Resolution1Guideline.definition: When an agenda item needs to be linked to a resolution, it is recommended that the resolution information directly follows the agenda item information to which the resolution is linked, as illustrated in the following example:|Resolution/IssuerLabel = Agenda item 1|Description = <Item description.>|ForInformationOnly = True|Type =.||Directly followed by||Resolution/IssuerLabel = Resolution 1|Description = <Resolution description.>|ForInformationOnly = False|Type =.|.

VoteInstructionType1Guideline.definition: If all of the vote instructions types are to be the same for all resolutions, it is recommended that only the element Vote/VoteInstructionType is used. If the vote instruction types are not going to be the same for each resolution, then it is recommended that only the element Resolution/VoteInstructionType in each occurrence of Resolution is used.

EntitlementDate1Guideline.definition: If both Meeting/EntitlementFixingDate and Security/Position/HoldingBalance/Date are present, it is recommended that both date values be identical.

PreviousNotificationIdentificationRule.definition: If NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationType is REPL (Replacement) and Pagination/PageNumber is equal to value 1, then NotificationUpdate/PreviousNotificationIdentification must be present.

AgentRole1Rule.definition: IssuerAgent/Role PRIN (PrincipalAgent) can only be present in a single occurrence of IssuerAgent.

VoteAsPerIntermediary1Rule.definition: If Vote/VoteMethod/VoteThroughNetwork/VoteChannel code value is VOPI (VoteAsPerIntermediaryInformation), then at least one occurrence of AdditionalInformation/ProcessingTextForNextIntermediary must be present.

PaginationRule.definition: If pagination is present, then NotificationGeneralInformation/NotificationIdentification must be present.

AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator1Rule.definition: If participation method is VIRT, then AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator must be set to Y.

AttendeeEmailRequiredIndicator2Rule.definition: If participation method is VIRT, then the email address of the party who will attend the virtual meeting must be provided in the Meeting Instruction.
